units.previous_finding: English: "Fetch returns the body of URL and a slice of URLs found on that page." Revised Marathi: "Fetch हे URL आणि त्या पृष्ठावर सापडलेल्या URL चा स्लाइस परत करते." The phrase "body of URL" is mistranslated/omitted: this currently says Fetch returns the URL itself instead of the body/content of the corresponding page. This is a material technical-semantic error in the Fetcher contract. The earlier mandatory slice -> स्लाइस issue is fixed, but the return-value description must be corrected without changing code, URLs or identifiers.

English: "// List represents a singly-linked list that holds // values of any type." Revised Marathi: "// List कोणत्याही टाइपची मूल्ये धारण करणाऱ्या एकदिश दुव्यांच्या यादीचे प्रतिनिधित्व करते // ." The previous singly-linked-list/type terminology defect is fixed, but the sentence-ending period was moved onto a separate standalone // . comment line. This is an avoidable formatting/readability defect; keep the two instructional comments natural without changing code or List/T identifiers.
